stem: Which statement about the transportation of these substances within the plant is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The minerals are transported from the phloem to the xylem in the shoot system.

options.label: B
options.text: The carbohydrates are transported from the shoot system to the fungi by the xylem.

options.label: C
options.text: The minerals are transported from the xylem to the phloem in the roots.

options.label: D
options.text: The carbohydrates are transported to the fungi through the phloem.

visual_elements: Roots of different plants can be connected by a network of underground fungal extensions called hyphae. These fungi contribute minerals to the plants, and the plants contribute carbohydrates to the fungi.
